def prune_attention_heads(model, attn_keep_masks: dict):
    """Prune GQA groups from the model by slicing weight matrices in-place.

    attn_keep_masks: dict[layer_idx -> list of GQA group indices to KEEP]
    Each GQA group = heads_per_kv Q heads + 1 KV head.
    """
    config = model.config
    n_heads = config.num_attention_heads
    n_kv_heads = config.num_key_value_heads
    head_dim = config.hidden_size // n_heads

        layer = model.model.layers[layer_idx]

        attn.k_proj.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(attn.k_proj.weight.data[kv_indices])

            attn.k_proj.bias = torch.nn.Parameter(attn.k_proj.bias.data[kv_indices])

        if val == int(val):
            return str(int(val))
        return str(val)
    except (ValueError, OverflowError):

    print(f"Model: {model_name} on {device}")

    # Weight shapes
    print("\n--- Weight shapes (sample layers) ---")
    for li in [0, 3, 6, 13, 27]:
        gate = model.model.layers[li].mlp.gate_proj.weight
        q = model.model.layers[li].self_attn.q_proj.weight
        print(f"Layer {li}: gate={list(gate.shape)}, q={list(q.shape)}, gate_std={gate.float().std():.6f}")
    
    # Activation check
    print("\n--- Activation check ---")
    text = "Question: Janet sells 16 eggs per day. How many does she sell in 4 days?\nAnswer:"
    inputs = tokenizer(text, return_tensors="pt").to(device)
    
    with torch.no_grad():
        outputs = model(**inputs, output_hidden_states=True)

        norm = hs.float().norm().item()
        has_nan = torch.isnan(hs).any().item()
        has_inf = torch.isinf(hs).any().item()
        mean_abs = hs.float().abs().mean().item()
        print(f"Layer {i:2d}: norm={norm:10.2f}, mean_abs={mean_abs:.6f}, nan={has_nan}, inf={has_inf}")
    
    # Generation test
    print("\n--- Generation test (3 samples) ---")
    prompts = [
        "Question: Janet sells 16 eggs per day. How many does she sell in 4 days?\nAnswer:",
